title: Collaboration & AI Platform Consolidation Strategy & Roadmap
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (Google Workspace + Gemini enterprise transformation; architecture/governance/integration or migration work, live-environment care).

Google Admin console + Microsoft/Entra authored click-by-click from public docs; Gemini Enterprise preview/rolling-out capabilities cited or flagged 'verify in tenant', never invented; third-party migration-tool and enterprise-app internals deferred to vendor docs.
hook: Turn a two-ecosystem mess into one sustainable platform
problem: A transformation that stalls in permanent coexistence carries double the cost, tools, and risk. This solution defines the long-term platform consolidation strategy across collaboration and AI systems — the target state, the decommission path for legacy Microsoft systems, the sequencing, and the sustainability/cost model — so the enterprise converges on one supportable platform instead of running two forever.
whats_inside: Strategy Overview — the consolidation thesis: target platform, what gets retired, and why (sustainability, security, cost efficiency).
Current-vs-Target Estate — a method to map the collaboration + AI estate (Microsoft, Google, third-party) to the target and identify redundancy and decommission candidates.
Consolidation Roadmap — sequencing, dependencies, decommission gates, and the coexistence-exit criteria that move the program off legacy systems deliberately.
5 supporting scripts — estate/redundancy discovery, target-state conformance validation, a consolidation/cost-savings report, safe decommission-readiness checks, and a scope helper.
Testing gates + a Consolidation-Roadmap document template and Best Practices for cost efficiency and long-term platform sustainability.
short: Define the long-term consolidation strategy across collaboration and AI systems — target state, decommission path for legacy Microsoft systems, sequencing, and cost model — so the enterprise converges on one supportable platform. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
short_plain: Define the long-term consolidation strategy across collaboration and AI systems — target state, decommission path for legacy Microsoft systems, sequencing, and cost model — so the enterprise converges on one supportable platform.
meta_title: Collaboration & AI Platform Consolidation Strategy & Roadmap
meta_description: Define a platform consolidation strategy for a Google transformation: target state, decommission path for legacy Microsoft systems, sequencing, and cost/sustainability model across collaboration and AI. Self-guided roadmap and scripts.
bottom_line: A clear, documented path to one consolidated collaboration + AI platform — legacy systems retired on a deliberate schedule — delivering sustainability, security, and cost efficiency.
